verdict.label: BUY MEDIUM — PCE Cleared; Iran MoU Pending Signature; Dell AH Warning; Protect the Run
verdict.rationale_short: Thursday's record closes (SPX 7,563.63, Nasdaq 26,917.47) confirmed the BUY thesis but two warning signs emerged: (1) 30Y had an intraday breach to 5.055% during the PCE digest before settling at 5.03% — trigger being tested rather than cleanly held; (2) Dell sold off −3.93% after-hours on a record $43.8B beat with $24.4B AI orders, the textbook AI-infrastructure sell-the-news pattern. Combined with month-end Friday rebalancing flows, the right Friday plan is protect-the-run: trim partials on spike to SPX 7,580+, hold XLE short at full size (Iran MoU signing by Trump is the binary), keep NVDA at $210 stop, do NOT add net-new size. The Iran MoU signature is the day's single largest potential catalyst.

bear_case: Dell's −3.93% AH on a record $43.8B beat is the canary for AI-infrastructure sell-the-news risk spreading. PLTR's +7.83% Thursday is the symmetrically-opposite signal — Iran resolution names getting all the bid while AI infra absorbs the selling. If the 30Y closes above 5.05% Friday on month-end bond buying being insufficient to offset PCE-driven yield back-up, the BUY framework is voided by Tuesday's open. Add the chip-sector sell-the-news pressure from Dell and the path of least resistance into next week is back to HOLD.
